title: Glyphsmith — Parametric Type Foundry
description: Sculpt a whole display typeface from nine parameters, then export it as vector SVG, PNG or an animated WebM specimen.
concept: Every glyph in Glyphsmith is a stroke skeleton — a set of polylines on a normalised cap-height grid — that gets inflated into filled outlines at render time. Nine parameters (weight, width, slant, contrast, terminals, serif, small-cap height, tracking, leading) reshape all 55 glyphs at once, so dragging one slider redraws an entire alphabet. Switch between a poster setting, a size waterfall and a full specimen sheet, dial in hollow/inline/duotone ink styles, then export real vector paths as SVG, a 2× PNG, or record the morph engine crossfading two cuts into a WebM clip.
features: 9 live parameters drive a hand-built 55-glyph stroke skeleton — weight, width, slant, contrast, terminal roundness, parametric slab serifs, small-cap height, tracking, leading
3 specimen views: auto-fitting poster with word wrap, size waterfall, and a clickable character map that appends glyphs to your text
9 built-in cuts (Grotesk, Slab, Didone, Condensed, Hairline, Oblique, Rounded, Backslant, Monolinear) plus your own named cuts saved to localStorage
Morph engine interpolates between any two cuts with adjustable speed, and 'freeze' commits the current frame back into the sliders
4 ink styles (solid, hollow, inline, duotone offset), 6 palettes, and a metrics overlay showing baseline / cap / small-cap lines
Export true vector SVG paths, a 2× PNG, or a WebM recording of the morph — plus a shareable URL hash that restores the whole design
Drag anywhere on the canvas to sculpt weight vertically and width horizontally; [ ] and , . nudge from the keyboard

interaction.mouse: Drag on the canvas to sculpt weight (vertical) and width (horizontal); sliders and preset chips reshape every glyph live.
interaction.click: Preset chips load a cut, palette swatches recolour, and in Specimen view clicking a glyph appends it to your text.
interaction.touch: Full touch drag on the canvas; the panel stacks below the stage on narrow screens.
interaction.keyboard: Space toggles the morph engine, [ and ] nudge weight, , and . nudge width.
